description: Social Engineering Village at DEF CON 24 explores the human elements of security, psychological manipulation, pretexting tradecraft, vishing, and interpersonal deception.

talks.title: SE Village - Tomohisa Ishikawa
talks.teaser: Exploring how cultural nuances, language habits, and regional social norms impact the effectiveness of social engineering techniques.

talks.title: SE Village - Steven Zani - How to Un Work Your Job
talks.teaser: Examining workplace dynamics, institutional bureaucracy, and interpersonal influence tactics to hack everyday corporate workflows.

talks.title: SE Village - Robert Anderson - US Interrogation Techniques and SE
talks.teaser: Comparing formal government interrogation methodologies with offensive social engineering and human intelligence elicitation tactics.

talks.title: SE Village - Panel - The Live SE Podcast 84
talks.teaser: A live recording of The Social-Engineer Podcast at DEF CON 24 featuring practitioner roundtables, stories, and audience Q&A.

talks.title: SE Village - Mattias Borg - SCAM CALL : Call Dropped
talks.teaser: Dissecting phone scams and social engineering call flows, analyzing caller techniques, victim psychological triggers, and defense strategies.

talks.title: SE Village - Jayson Street - Total Fail: and Bad Mistakes, I've Made a Few
talks.teaser: Jayson Street shares candid war stories, critical missteps, and key operational lessons learned from physical security engagements.

talks.title: SE Village - James Powell
talks.teaser: Deconstructing cognitive biases, emotional vulnerabilities, and influence techniques used to manipulate individuals in everyday life.

talks.title: SE Village - Fadli Sidek - Advanced SE Techniques and The Rise of cyber scams
talks.teaser: Analyzing advanced psychological manipulation and modern online fraud syndicates exploiting digital communications platforms.

talks.title: SE Village - David Kennedy -The Wizard of Oz
talks.teaser: David Kennedy demonstrates the art of creating believable deceptive realities and immersive pretexts during red team operations.

talks.title: SE Village - Cyni Winegard, Bethany Ward - Human Hacking: You ARE the Weak Link
talks.teaser: Examining why people remain the most vulnerable target in security perimeters, and how organizations can cultivate proactive defense.

talks.title: SE Village - Chris Hadnagy - 7 Jedi Mind Tricks: Influence Your Target without a Word
talks.teaser: Chris Hadnagy reveals nonverbal influence, body language cues, and psychological rapport-building tactics for social engineering.
